[[File:Mr Honcho.png|thumb|Mr. Honcho|250px]] '''Mr. Honcho''' (Japanese: '''オオイシ先生''' ''Mr. Ohishi'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is the head teacher at the {{ci|Snowpoint}} {{pkmn|Trainers' School}}. ==History== Mr. Honcho has been the head teacher at the {{ci|Snowpoint}} {{pkmn|Trainers' School}} for quiet some time. Some of his notable students included [[Candice]] and [[Zoey]]. When the two of them were younger, Mr. Honcho discovered that they were secretly raising a {{TP|Zoey|Glameow}} in the school after hours. He told Zoey that she would have to turn Glameow in to the [[Pokémon Center]], but Candice eventually convinced him otherwise. He agreed to let Zoey keep Glameow, but under the condition that Candice would help in taking care of it. He debuted in ''[[DP126|Classroom Training!]]''. Mr. Honcho was blindsided by {{TRT}}, who infiltrated the School as new students and attempted to steal all of the School's Pokémon. He managed to trigger the fire alarm, alerting Candice and the others, who dealt with the trio and recovered the stolen Pokémon. He reappeared in ''[[DP127|Sliding Into Seventh!]]'', where he was the [[Battle judge|referee]] for the [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} between {{Ash}} and Candice. ==Character== Mr. Honcho is well respected by his students. He is renowned for his kindness and enthusiasm. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=石塚運昇 ''[[Unshō Ishizuka]]'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |fi=Arto Nieminen |it=Mario Scarabelli |no=Simen Sand |es_eu=Roberto Cuenca Martínez |cs=Ladislav Cigánek |pt_br=Vágner Santos |pl=Janusz Wituch}}
